QuestInfo.2: You were able to eliminate the undead monsters and acquired the title of #b<Saint Exorcist>#k.

0.0: Your spirit is more hardened than ever, and your history supports that theory. That being said, I see your eyes lingering with doubt. Are you beginning to question your identity? Well, the answer can be found within yourself. Do you wish to conclude the trip that allowed you to seek for the answer?

yes.0: Evil spirits at times use their powerful force to influence the pure spirits nearby. Please stop them from doing so. Then, and only then, will you acquire the title of <Saint Exorcist>...

no.0: It's okay if you don't trust me, but it's not okay for you to lose faith in yourself. That's what's important.

1.0: The spirits of darkness will no longer be able to attack you anymore, because you are now a <Saint Exorcist>...

default.0: They should all be incinerated and sent to nirvana, but I don't think you have enough experience to make that happen yet.
